title: Chapter 107 — The Warehouse, Returns, and Reverse Logistics
intro: Receiving, the returns machine, and recycling obligations.

sections.title: Returns Are Inevitable
sections.content:
Not every sale sticks. Products get damaged. Customers change their minds. Wrong models get ordered. Understanding the returns process — how to initiate one, what the costs are, and how to prevent them — makes you a better salesperson.

The best way to reduce returns is to get the sale right the first time: accurate discovery, correct measurements, verified specifications, and clear expectations.

sections.title: Coaching Rule
sections.content:
When evaluating returns awareness, ask:

Does the salesperson understand the returns process and its costs?
Are they preventing returns through accurate selling — or creating them through shortcuts?
Do they handle return situations professionally — maintaining the customer relationship?
